{{Quote|from the sands of Socorro to the seas of Seffi|The motto of the [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]]|<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>}}
'''Seffi''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Rhinnal system/Legends|Rhinnal system]]. The planet's surface was covered by a toxic ocean.<ref name="CC" /> The [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]] distinguished themselves through their actions on Seffi, which was later reflected in their motto.<ref name="GaW" /><ref name="Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>
